name: reporter_cluster_lines_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Lines family reporters: xy_lines (L1-L22 + L5b), cs_lines (L1-L16), labeled_lines (L1-L7), cs_labeled_lines (L1-L4). All 5 CardRenderType formats, axis labels/dp, plot bands, overlays, step, band mode, split-by-label, line_width/dash_style, data_labels, AssetFilterSchema. 51 layouts + 32 agg diversity.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Lines Family Handbook — All 27 Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_5 = sma(close, 5)
sma_10 = sma(close, 10)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
sma_60 = sma(close, 60)
sma_120 = sma(close, 120)
sma_200 = sma(close, 200)
ema_12 = ema(close, 12)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
ts = index()

# Running count (numeric X axis)
ones = close / close
bar_count = agg(ones, AggregationType.Sum)

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
day_of_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(ts)

# Proxy series for stacked area
norm_close = close / sma_200

# Step signal (above/below SMA 50)
position_flag = 1.0 if close > sma_50 else 0.0

# Big-down flag for band mode
big_down = 1.0 if daily_ret < -0.01 else 0.0

# 1Y ago SMA versions for labeled_lines L2
sma_5_1y = sma_5 >> 252
sma_10_1y = sma_10 >> 252
sma_20_1y = sma_20 >> 252
sma_60_1y = sma_60 >> 252
sma_120_1y = sma_120 >> 252

# Factor proxies for cs_labeled_lines L2
momentum = close / (close >> 60) - 1
quality = sma_50 / sma_200
size_proxy = close / sma_20
value_proxy = (close >> 20) / close

# SMA deviations for labeled_lines L3
dev_5 = sma_5 - close
dev_10 = sma_10 - close
dev_20 = sma_20 - close
dev_60 = sma_60 - close
dev_120 = sma_120 - close

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL LINES (cs_lines) — L1 through L7
# ========================================================================

# L1: Per-asset lines (default, no agg)
cs_lines(
    title='L1: Per-Asset Cumulative Return',
    category='01 cs_lines L1: Per-Asset'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L2: Aggregated single line
cs_lines(
    title='L2: Mean Daily Return Across Assets',
    category='02 cs_lines L2: Aggregated',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L3: Aggregated with max_assets limit
cs_lines(
    title='L3: Median (Max 2 Assets)',
    category='03 cs_lines L3: Filtered+Agg',
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    max_assets=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L4: Per-asset with colors
cs_lines(
    title='L4: Per-Asset with Custom Colors',
    category='04 cs_lines L4: Colors',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green],
    max_assets=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L5: Stacked area (multi-asset)
cs_lines(
    title='L5: Stacked Area',
    category='05 cs_lines L5: Stacked Area',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack
)(x_values=ts, y_values=norm_close)

# L6: 100% stacked area
cs_lines(
    title='L6: 100% Stacked Area',
    category='06 cs_lines L6: Percent Stack',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.PercentStack
)(x_values=ts, y_values=norm_close)

# L7: With reference line
cs_lines(
    title='L7: Daily Return with Zero Reference',
    category='07 cs_lines L7: Reference Line',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L8: PercentFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L8: Daily Return (PercentFormat)',
    category='07a cs_lines L8: PercentFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L9: BpsFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L9: Daily Return (BpsFormat)',
    category='07b cs_lines L9: BpsFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L10: MonetaryFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L10: Close (MonetaryFormat)',
    category='07c cs_lines L10: MonetaryFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L11: IntegerFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L11: Close (IntegerFormat)',
    category='07d cs_lines L11: IntegerFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L12: line_width + dash_style
cs_lines(
    title='L12: Dashed Wide Lines',
    category='07e cs_lines L12: LineStyle',
    line_width=3,
    dash_style=DashStyle.Dash
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L13: data_labels
cs_lines(
    title='L13: Per-Asset with Data Labels',
    category='07f cs_lines L13: DataLabels',
    data_labels=True,
    max_assets=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L14: axis labels + format
cs_lines(
    title='L14: Full Axis Config',
    category='07g cs_lines L14: AxisLabels',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L15: AssetFilterSchema (top 2 by y_values)
cs_lines(
    title='L15: Top 2 Assets by Return',
    category='07h cs_lines L15: Filter',
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[AssetFilter(column=1, count=2, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L16: Filter + agg_filtered (aggregate only filtered assets)
cs_lines(
    title='L16: Sum of Top 2 Assets',
    category='07i cs_lines L16: FilterAgg',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    agg_filtered=True,
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[AssetFilter(column=1, count=2, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL LABELED LINES (cs_labeled_lines) — L1, L2
# ========================================================================

# L1: SMA profiles by asset (yield curve analog)
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L1: SMA Profiles by Asset',
    category='08 cs_labeled_lines L1: Yield Curves',
    x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
    agg=AggregationType.Last
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# L2: Factor profiles with colors
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L2: Factor Profiles by Asset',
    category='09 cs_labeled_lines L2: Factor Profiles',
    x_labels=['Value', 'Momentum', 'Quality', 'Size'],
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green]
)(value_proxy, momentum, quality, size_proxy)

# ========================================================================
# XY LINES (xy_lines) — L1 through L15
# ========================================================================

# L1: Single series, numeric X
xy_lines(
    title='L1: Return vs Bar Index',
    category='10 xy_lines L1: Numeric X',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=daily_ret)

# L2: Multi-series with schema
xy_lines(
    title='L2: Close vs SMA 20',
    category='11 xy_lines L2: Multi-Series',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(close, sma_20))

# L3: Area fill
xy_lines(
    title='L3: Cumulative Return (Area)',
    category='12 xy_lines L3: Area Fill',
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L4: Per-series area override (mixed line + area)
xy_lines(
    title='L4: Mixed Line + Area',
    category='13 xy_lines L4: Mixed Area',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Return', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Daily Return', color=Color.Red, area=False)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cum_ret, daily_ret))

# L5: Stacked area
xy_lines(
    title='L5: Stacked SMA 20 + SMA 50',
    category='14 xy_lines L5: Stacked Area',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(sma_20, sma_50))

# L5b: 100% stacked area
xy_lines(
    title='L5b: 100% Stacked SMA 20 + SMA 50',
    category='14b xy_lines L5b: Percent Stack',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.PercentStack,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(sma_20, sma_50))

# L6: Step function
xy_lines(
    title='L6: Position Flag (Step)',
    category='15 xy_lines L6: Step Function',
    step=StepType.StepLeft,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=position_flag)

# L7: Split by label
xy_lines(
    title='L7: Cumulative Return by Year',
    category='16 xy_lines L7: Split By Label',
    split_by_label=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=day_of_year, y_values=cum_ret, label=year_num)

# L8: Aggregated category mode (per-series agg)
xy_lines(
    title='L8: Average Return by Month',
    category='17 xy_lines L8: Category Mode',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Avg Return', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ])
)(x_values=month_num, y_values=daily_ret)

# L9: Band mode (shaded regions)
xy_lines(
    title='L9: Close with Big-Down Bands',
    category='18 xy_lines L9: Band Mode',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Big Down Day', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(close, big_down))

# L10: Reference lines (horizontal)
xy_lines(
    title='L10: Daily Return with +/-2% Reference',
    category='19 xy_lines L10: Reference Lines',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.02, title='+2%', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.02, title='-2%', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=daily_ret)

# L11: Spline + data labels
xy_lines(
    title='L11: SMA 50 (Smooth + Labels)',
    category='20 xy_lines L11: Spline+Labels',
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=sma_50)

# L12: Log scale
xy_lines(
    title='L12: Close (Log Scale)',
    category='21 xy_lines L12: Log Scale',
    log_scale=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L13: Timestamp X (auto-detected)
xy_lines(
    title='L13: Close on Timestamp X',
    category='22 xy_lines L13: Timestamp X',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L14: Y plot bands (overbought/oversold zones)
xy_lines(
    title='L14: RSI with Zones',
    category='23 xy_lines L14: Plot Bands',
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=30, to=70, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Neutral'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI 14', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rsi_14)

# L15: Overlay lines
xy_lines(
    title='L15: Close with SMA 50 Overlay',
    category='24 xy_lines L15: Overlay Lines',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close, overlays=sma_50)

# L16: PercentFormat y_axis
xy_lines(
    title='L16: Daily Return (PercentFormat)',
    category='24a xy_lines L16: PercentFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Return', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L17: BpsFormat y_axis
xy_lines(
    title='L17: Daily Return (BpsFormat)',
    category='24b xy_lines L17: BpsFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Return', color=Color.Red)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L18: MonetaryFormat y_axis
xy_lines(
    title='L18: Close Price (MonetaryFormat)',
    category='24c xy_lines L18: MonetaryFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L19: IntegerFormat y_axis
xy_lines(
    title='L19: Close Price (IntegerFormat)',
    category='24d xy_lines L19: IntegerFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L20: Axis labels
xy_lines(
    title='L20: Full Axis Labels',
    category='24e xy_lines L20: AxisLabels',
    x_axis_label='Trading Day',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=cum_ret)

# L21: y_axis_dp (custom decimal places)
xy_lines(
    title='L21: Custom DP (4)',
    category='24f xy_lines L21: AxisDP',
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=daily_ret)

# L22: x_plot_bands
xy_lines(
    title='L22: X Plot Bands (Q1/Q2 shading)',
    category='24g xy_lines L22: XPlotBands',
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=63, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Q1'),
        PlotBand(from=63, to=126, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.05, label='Q2')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Y', color=Color.Blue)])
)(x_values=bar_count, y_values=cum_ret)

# ========================================================================
# LABELED LINES (labeled_lines) — L1, L2, L3
# ========================================================================

# L1: Single series (SMA profile as yield curve analog)
labeled_lines(
    title='L1: SMA Profile',
    category='25 labeled_lines L1: Single Series',
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Current SMA', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# L2: Multi-series overlay (current vs 1Y ago)
labeled_lines(
    title='L2: Current vs 1Y Ago SMA',
    category='26 labeled_lines L2: Multi-Series',
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, agg=AggregationType.Last)
        ]
    )
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120, sma_5_1y, sma_10_1y, sma_20_1y, sma_60_1y, sma_120_1y)

# L3: With reference line
labeled_lines(
    title='L3: SMA Deviation with Zero Reference',
    category='27 labeled_lines L3: Reference Line',
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='SMA - Close', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    ),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(dev_5, dev_10, dev_20, dev_60, dev_120)

# ========================================================================
# LABELED_LINES — FORMAT DIVERSITY (4 formats + 2 cs)
# ========================================================================

# Percentage returns for format testing
ret_1w = (close - (close >> 5)) / (close >> 5)
ret_2w = (close - (close >> 10)) / (close >> 10)
ret_1m = (close - (close >> 21)) / (close >> 21)
ret_3m = (close - (close >> 63)) / (close >> 63)
ret_6m = (close - (close >> 126)) / (close >> 126)

# L4: PercentFormat (returns scaled x100)
labeled_lines(
    title='L4: Return Profile (PercentFormat)',
    category='28 labeled_lines L4: PercentFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['1W', '2W', '1M', '3M', '6M'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Return', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(ret_1w, ret_2w, ret_1m, ret_3m, ret_6m)

# L5: BpsFormat (returns scaled x10000)
labeled_lines(
    title='L5: Return Profile (BpsFormat)',
    category='29 labeled_lines L5: BpsFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['1W', '2W', '1M', '3M', '6M'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Return', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(ret_1w, ret_2w, ret_1m, ret_3m, ret_6m)

# L6: MonetaryFormat (SMA values as dollar amounts)
labeled_lines(
    title='L6: SMA Profile (MonetaryFormat)',
    category='30 labeled_lines L6: MonetaryFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='SMA', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# L7: IntegerFormat (SMA values as whole numbers)
labeled_lines(
    title='L7: SMA Profile (IntegerFormat)',
    category='31 labeled_lines L7: IntegerFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='SMA', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# cs_labeled_lines format: PercentFormat
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L3: Return Profile (PercentFormat)',
    category='32 cs_labeled_lines L3: PercentFormat',
    x_labels=['1W', '2W', '1M', '3M', '6M'],
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(ret_1w, ret_2w, ret_1m, ret_3m, ret_6m)

# cs_labeled_lines format: BpsFormat
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L4: Return Profile (BpsFormat)',
    category='33 cs_labeled_lines L4: BpsFormat',
    x_labels=['1W', '2W', '1M', '3M', '6M'],
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat
)(ret_1w, ret_2w, ret_1m, ret_3m, ret_6m)

# ========================================================================
# CS_LINES — AGG DIVERSITY (16 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Sum',
    title='Agg Diversity: Sum'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Last',
    title='Agg Diversity: Last'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Min',
    title='Agg Diversity: Min'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Max',
    title='Agg Diversity: Max'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Std',
    title='Agg Diversity: Std'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Count',
    title='Agg Diversity: Count'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=First',
    title='Agg Diversity: First'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=All',
    title='Agg Diversity: All'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Any',
    title='Agg Diversity: Any'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=CountDistinct',
    title='Agg Diversity: CountDistinct'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Kurtosis',
    title='Agg Diversity: Kurtosis'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Mode',
    title='Agg Diversity: Mode'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Product',
    title='Agg Diversity: Product'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

cs_lines(
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    category='AD cs_lines agg=Quantile',
    title='Agg Diversity: Quantile'
